name: worldboss
description: Multiplayer Boss Fighting Game inspired by Cookie Clicker

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.clean: rm -rf backend/dist frontend/dist node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules
